thread:
anna: Draft ready — short launch post draft + compact benchmark sidebar. Need copypass, legal quick-check, and inbound routing for webinar CTA. Target publish Wed AM. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft (comments inline)

jamal: glancing now — can you highlight the benchmark source? I want to make sure the throughput numbers map to the Dedicated config we tested.

anna: good call. benchmark footnote is a Google Sheet table row 4. I put a parenthetical: (internal perf kit, median across 4 runs). ok to be more explicit? 

leo: quick legal note — avoid absolute claims like "3x cheaper" unless we include the test config and model versions. Suggest "up to 3x lower unit cost in our tests" or cite the sheet link.

anna: updated text to: "up to 3x lower unit cost in our tests (see methodology)" — pushed new draft.

sarah: hero image suggestion: use the latency-vs-cost chart — crop to 1200x630. also can we add an inset showing the webinar CTA button? small mock attached in Figma.

mike: routing question: webinar registrants should map to HubSpot list "Launch Webinar - Redwood Inference" and get tag: "interest:launch-webinar". Also we need UTM mapping for paid promos.

mike: UTM snippet for reference:

    utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign=launch_may&utm_term=llm_inference

anna: perfect — can we standardize campaign name to launch_may_2024? makes reporting easier.

mike: yep, use launch_may_2024. Also please add hidden field on reg form: campaign_id=launch_may_2024

jamal: small content nit — in the third paragraph we talk about "smart routing". suggest one sentence to clarify fallback behavior: "requests auto-fallback to compatible model variants when capacity is constrained (configurable per-route)."

anna: added that line.

leo: skimming again — one more ask: remove the phrase "guaranteed latency" and replace with "latency targets backed by SLAs for Dedicated". ok?

anna: done.

mike: one more ops thing — inbound lead mapping to HubSpot: use contact property `first_touch_campaign=launch_may_2024` and owner assignment rule: if company_size > 250 then owner = Enterprise AE queue else owner = SDR queue.

anna: noted — i've added the mapping doc to the sheet.

publish-bot: draft scheduled -> review window opens: 2024-05-13 16:00 UTC. Automated preflight checklist will run on publish.

sarah: small copy tweak: change CTA from "Sign up" to "Reserve a spot" — nicer for webinars.

anna: changed CTA, updated Figma mock, and flagged for final pass. Who's green for publish approval?

mike: green from growth side. :thumbsup:

jamal: green on product accuracy. :white_check_mark:

leo: legal ok with edits. :ok_hand:

sarah: design good. :sparkles:

anna: awesome — locking copy now. final publish window set to 2024-05-15 09:00 PST. thanks team! :rocket:
